result.rationale: The diff shows `AdminEmbeddingController#saveChanges` calls `this.get('embedding').update({})`, while `admin-embedding.hbs` only has an `addHost` button and no save button bound to `saveChanges`. Server-side, `PUT customize/embedding` maps to `embedding#update`, which only re-renders `@embedding` and persists nothing. This is an incomplete/dead no-op endpoint and action, creating a real risk if future UI is wired to it. It is not a current defect because no diff-provided UI invokes it.
